sources.content: .cursorrules for edrith. Edrith is a Prometheus exporter for network switches, written in Python 3.12. It polls switches over SNMP and serves metrics on port 9620. Use uv for everything: `uv sync` to install and `uv run pytest` to test. Source lives in `src/edrith/`, and each switch vendor gets its own module in `src/edrith/vendors/`. Type hints are required on all public functions, and `mypy --strict` must pass. Run `uv run ruff check` before committing, because CI fails on any lint error.

Never poll a switch more often than every 60 seconds, because some older models reboot under heavy SNMP load. Metric names start with `edrith_` and use snake_case. Tests must not reach real devices; use the recorded SNMP walks in `tests/walks/`. Keep the default SNMP timeout at 5 seconds with 2 retries. Do not add new runtime dependencies without asking the maintainers. Docs are in `docs/` and built with `mkdocs build`.

claims.text: Edrith tests use the recorded SNMP walks in tests/walks/.
Each switch vendor gets its own module in src/edrith/vendors/.
Edrith's default SNMP timeout is 10 seconds.
Edrith must never poll a switch more often than every 60 seconds.
